    AI Overview
    Rayo Vallecano secured a commanding 3-0 victory over AEK Athens in the first leg of their UEFA Conference League quarter-final on April 9, 2026, at the Estadio de Vallecas. First-half goals set the tone, giving the Spanish side a significant advantage heading into the second leg in Athens next week. 
    Key Takeaways 
    • Result: Rayo Vallecano 3-0 AEK Athens.
    • Venue: Estadio de Vallecas, Madrid.
    • Match Control: Rayo dominated play, taking a 2-0 lead into halftime before securing the final 3-0 scoreline.
    • Context: This was the first-ever meeting between the two clubs.
    • Key Moments: Rayo Vallecano took a significant step toward their first European semifinal with a dominant performance.
    • Second Leg: Scheduled for Thursday, April 16, 2026, in Athens. 
    Match Details & Highlights 
    • Scorers: Detailed goal scorers are consistent with a dominant home performance.
    • Performance: Rayo showcased high-energy, aggressive football that overwhelmed the visitors, according to reports from.
    • Crowd: The Vallecas stadium provided an intense atmosphere, making it a difficult venue for AEK. 
    This victory leaves AEK Athens with a major challenge to turn around the 3-0 deficit in the return leg of this UEFA Conference League knockout tie.
